evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps straight into property details: 'I just wanted to check the first location that we have here is 5200, Martell Avenue... what is your unit number?' — no time-box framing, no explicit wait for confirmation.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment/house), floor/stories (3rd floor no elevator; 1-story house), rooms (1 bed apt; 3 bed house), walking distance (10 steps to stairs, 3 flights, <15 sec to door; 50 feet driveway), special considerations (driveway slope prevents truck backing), items (couch, books, shelf, recliner, table, TV console, dresser, bed frame/mattress). Box count: 'typical one bedroom apartment would be 15 to 25 boxes' asked.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Asked: 'Do you need help in packing?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given ('typical one bedroom apartment would normally take two movers, that is between two and a half to three and a half hours') but estimate not personalized to customer's specific prep level or concerns until later ('in case if you just have extra time just to prepare... this would really help to keep the time down').
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full disclosure: 'we charge an hourly rate of 105 dollars per hour per mover... Everything is already included... gas trucks, taxes and insurance all the wraps, the pods, the bunds... we also have a minimum of two and a half hours once you go over that it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep gives estimate ('estimated cost would be $840') and moves directly into scheduling without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or waiting for customer response.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Delivered: 'we have on time Guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Delivered: 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the R D Weight that you're paying us we will provide up to 2000 dollars remove that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.' — covers $2,000, no deductible framing, built into rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' and repeats no-hidden-fees messaging ('there's no other fees or like, extra fees') after already stating it earlier.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'no worries' and customer responds, but no genuine concern-mining question like 'What's still concerning you about this move?' — equivalent to throwaway.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full: 'I think all that sounds good, I think we can lock in that time in that price too' — customer states willingness to lock in, and rep confirms: 'I'll send you a confirmation email.' No soft out offered.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Mentioned: 'no deposit required no rest and securing your spot.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (Friday 16th October), time (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), phone (rep does not explicitly confirm phone number in final summary), addresses (5200 Martell Avenue, 155 Bon Air Drive), crew size (two movers), special note (bed frame disassembly/reassembly). Partial — phone number not explicitly re-confirmed at booking.

top_strength: Exceptional logistics discovery — gathered all seven details (property type, floors, rooms, walking distance, additional storage, special considerations, items list) with genuine follow-up and clarification, and seamlessly wove in packing offer and box-count check.
coaching_note: Open with the quid pro quo framing ('10 to 15 minutes, walk away with a dependable quote, does that sound good?') before diving into discovery, and ask Their Agenda ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?') before probing — these two moves set the call structure and build trust.
